 Fairfield police working shooting incident at Solano Town Center
 By
 Coleman Petit 
 Updated on: October 30, 2026 / 9:59 PM PDT 
 / CBS Sacramento
 Add CBS News on Google 
 Fairfield police are working a shooting incident at the Solano Town Center shopping mall, officials said Friday night.
 No other details were immediately available about the incident, but there will be a press conference tonight, police said. Fairfield Mayor Rick Vaccaro said it was a shooting at the mall, but did not know how many people had been injured.
 This is a developing story that will be updated as new information becomes available.
